Select assay_chembl_id, target_type, tax_id, canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, pchembl_value from activities joined to assays on assay_id, target_dictionary on assays.tid, molecule_dictionary on activities.molregno, and compound_structures on molecule_dictionary.molregno. Filter to target CHEMBL1839, standard_type IC50, standard_relation '=', and pchembl_value not null. Keep every qualifying activity row without deduplication. Sort by molecule_chembl_id then assay_chembl_id. Limit to 1000 rows.
